content:
Posted fast proof broadcast protocol (framed it as an EIP in the write up)

https://notes.ethereum.org/@kamilsa/rk_I4TMJme

TLDR It is based on the 8411 with waggle ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12671/changes)) : proof is chunked and then merkle tree is built on top. Root is signed by leanXMSS. Chunk size is ~3KB, signature size is 2.4KB, so we send signature only with the first chunk to the remote peer

Also vibed a Lighthouse branch on top of the pq-devnet-0 branch: https://github.com/kamilsa/lighthouse/tree/leanvm-proof-broadcast 

Kurtosis instructions: https://gist.github.com/kamilsa/8eedc3a0e9ac162be22353b824d64d17
